key_decisions.rationale: Preserves joint work, appeal, and risk of empty reception.
key_decisions.before: And working together with him, we also urge you not to receive the grace of God in vain.
key_decisions.after: Working together with God, we also urge you not to receive God's grace in vain.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the servant claim and opening catalogue.

key_decisions.after: Instead, in everything we commend ourselves as God's servants: through great endurance, in afflictions, hardships, and distress,

key_decisions.after: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots, in hard work, sleepless nights, and hunger,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the escalating paradoxes and punishment.
key_decisions.before: as unknown and yet known; as dying, and look, we live; as disciplined, and not killed;
key_decisions.after: as unknown, yet fully known; as dying, yet look—we live; as punished, yet not put to death;

key_decisions.rationale: Retains sorrow, poverty, and possession paradoxes.
key_decisions.before: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, yet possessing everything.
key_decisions.after: as grieving, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, yet possessing everything.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, yet possessing everything.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves repeated constriction and inward location.
key_decisions.before: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted in your own affections.
key_decisions.after: You are not confined by us, but you are confined in your own affections.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted in your own affections.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains yoking image and paired rhetorical contrasts.
key_decisions.before: Do not be mismatched with unbelievers. For what partnership has righteousness with lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?
key_decisions.after: Do not be mismatched with unbelievers. For what partnership do righteousness and lawlessness have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do not be mismatched with unbelievers. For what partnership has righteousness with lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the proper name and two relational questions.
key_decisions.before: What accord has Christ with Belial? Or what portion does a believer share with an unbeliever?
key_decisions.after: What agreement does Christ have with Beliar? Or what share does a believer have with an unbeliever?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: What accord has Christ with Belial? Or what portion does a believer share with an unbeliever?

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves communal temple identity and covenant quotation.
key_decisions.before: What agreement has the temple of God with idols? For we are the temple of the living God; as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
key_decisions.after: What agreement does God's temple have with idols? For we are the living God's temple, as God said: “I will dwell and walk among them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: What agreement has the temple of God with idols? For we are the temple of the living God; as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
